report.answer_text:
GPT-5 is OpenAI's flagship large language model. OpenAI released it on August 7, 2025.[1] It is a multimodal model and became the default model in ChatGPT.[2]
Main new features
Unified system with a router. GPT-5 combines a fast, efficient model for most questions, a deeper reasoning model ("GPT-5 thinking") for harder problems, and a real-time router. The router chooses between them based on conversation type and complexity.[1] This removes the old split between OpenAI's flagship models and its o-series reasoning models.[3] Users no longer have to pick a model themselves.
Better coding and agentic abilities. OpenAI called it its strongest coding model to date.[1] It produces high-quality code and generates front-end UI with minimal prompting. OpenAI also cites improvements in personality, steerability, and running long chains of tool calls.[4]
Fewer hallucinations and more efficient reasoning.
With web search on, OpenAI says GPT-5's responses are about 45% less likely to contain a factual error than GPT-4o's. When thinking, they are about 80% less likely than OpenAI o3's.[1]
GPT-5 with thinking beat o3 while using 50–80% fewer output tokens.[1]
Broad performance gains. OpenAI claimed state-of-the-art performance across coding, math, writing, health, visual perception, and more.[1]
New developer/API features.
It comes in three API sizes (gpt-5, gpt-5-mini, and gpt-5-nano), so developers can trade off performance, cost, and latency.[5]
The reasoning_effort parameter adds a "minimal" setting, which returns answers quickly with little reasoning.[5]
A verbosity parameter controls response length. Free-form function calling sends raw text to tools. Context-free grammars enforce specific output formats.[6]
The API model handles text and vision, with a 400K context window and 128K max output tokens.[4]
Input limits. Native video and audio processing was not included in the initial release.[6] Some pre-launch speculation had predicted it.
Since launch
OpenAI has released several updates since then. One source says GPT-5.1 through 5.6 shipped within 11 months[7]. It also says the original GPT-5 was retired from ChatGPT on Feb 13, 2026[7]. Details on the later versions come from a single secondary source, so check OpenAI's official announcements for them.
